purpose: Post-hoc oracle mechanism diagnosis after H1ai on the same seen32 banks and5000 puzzles. Not a deployable learned method and not fresh confirmation.

interventions.base: Archived H1ai evidence weights and trajectories.
interventions.repair_true: Exactly82 weak true edge-bank weights1/16->1; all others unchanged.
interventions.soften_strong_extra: Exactly503 strong extra edge-bank weights1->1/16; all others unchanged.
interventions.delete_weak_extra: Exactly19445 weak extra edge-bank weights1/16->0; all others unchanged; independent proof that no true edge is deleted.

endpoints.repair_true: Paired canonical accuracy difference versus base equivalent within[-5,+5]pp: support iff entire marginal95%CI lies inside; falsify iff entireCI lies above+5 or below-5; else inconclusive.
endpoints.soften_strong_extra: Paired canonical accuracy gain versus base>=10pp: support iff lower95%>=10, falsify iff upper95%<10, else inconclusive.
endpoints.delete_weak_extra: Paired canonical accuracy gain versus base>=10pp: support iff lower95%>=10, falsify iff upper95%<10, else inconclusive.

endpoint_scope: Three separate endpoints; no conjunction, joint dominance or simultaneous-coverage claim. Nominal95% bootstrap intervals are not adjusted for selecting this mechanism study afterH1ai.
bootstrap: Paired two-way resampling of32 banks and the same5000 puzzle indices; unchanged helper returns percentage units.
accuracy: Canonical exact match including capped returns. Report correct certificates, correct capped outputs, canonical compatibility, clue-only infeasibility and noncanonical valid returns separately; do not assume uniqueness.
validity: Zero invalid certified stops required. No certificates makes gate explicitly vacuous. Exact scaled integer energy, clue preservation and ordinary Sudoku validity independently checked for every returned board.
support_semantics: Repair/softening preserve positive support and zero set. Deleting weak extras expands the zero set, may raise compatibility, and is not a positive-support-preserving intervention. All810 true edges stay positive in every arm, retaining sound zero-energy validity.
fixed_search: Unit1, temp.4->.31, theta.45, four chains, tau0,ebar0,tol.001,anneal524288,check4096,cap262144; same paired seeds and inputs asH1ai. No normalization, tuning or sample extension.
deduplication: Reuse archived evidence baseline and any new arm only when complete weight bytes, input hash and row slice, search seed, backend/capture and every search setting are identical. Never dedup by support alone.
preflight: Historical H1ah nonuniform backend checks reused. Each fresh search runs150 general/sparse and132 hidden-target comparisons plus6 exact integer field/energy/focus/certificate checks, including127 moves without refresh.
budget: At most30 new GPU-min, measured by four-GPU wall envelope across all new searches including their preflight checks. No new standalone GPU preflights, no adaptive extension. Archived baseline cost is not charged twice.
stopping_rule: Exactly128 requested bank/arm cells; reuse identical archived/new outcomes, run only new unique cells, no tuning or additional inputs.
limitations: Post-hoc oracle study selected after H1ai; same seen banks and puzzles.
Known Sudoku geometry deliberately used to identify true and extra edges.
No new learned-method or fresh-test generalization claim.
Approximate marginal bootstrap intervals, not simultaneous or selection-adjusted.
Positive energy returned-best accuracy differs from certificate capacity.
BP AdamW outside this mechanism study; not run.
